column2: 中古英语 swymmen ← 古英语 swimman（游、浮）← 原始日耳曼语 *swimmaną（游）← 原始印欧语 *swem-（晃动、移动、游）
column3: to move through water using the arms and legs
column5: She swims twice a week.|The dog swam to the far bank.
column6: moving oneself through water without touching bottom – 不着底，靠自身动作在水里前进
column7: 游泳：把这件事当运动说|游：单指在水中行进这个动作|漂浮：不使力也能停在水面这一层

column2: 中古英语 swyngen ← 古英语 swingan（挥、甩）← 原始日耳曼语 *swinganą ← 原始印欧语 *sweng-（弯、挥）
column3: to move back and forth while hanging from a fixed point
column5: The gate swung open in the wind.|He swung the axe over his shoulder.
column6: hanging from one point and travelling in an arc – 一端固定，另一端划着弧来回走
column7: 摇荡：吊着的东西来回划弧|挥动：手臂或器物划出同样的弧|转变：立场像挂着的东西那样倒向另一边

column2: 英语 switch 或借自中古荷兰语 swijch（细枝），1592 年前后始见；「扳动装置」义 1797 年始见，本指矿车木轨上可转动的活轨
column3: a device for turning something on or off, or a change from one thing to another
column5: He flicked the switch and the room went dark.|They made a switch to cheaper suppliers.
column6: a small movement that sends things down another path – 一个小动作，把去向换到另一条路上
column7: 开关：扳一下就通断电流的装置|转换：从一种状态改到另一种|调换：把两者的位置对换

column2: 中古英语 sword ← 古英语 sweord ← 原始日耳曼语 *swerdą（剑），或出自原始印欧语 *seh₂w-（锐利）
column3: a weapon with a long metal blade and a handle
column5: He drew his sword from its sheath.|The museum displays medieval swords.
column6: a long blade held by a hilt, made for cutting and thrusting – 带柄的长刃，用来劈与刺
column7: 剑：两面开刃的那种长兵|刀剑：连着刀一起说的通称

column2: 借自法语 symbole ← 拉丁语 symbolum（记号、凭信）← 希腊语 symbolon（借以推知之物），由 syn-（一同）＋ ballo（投、放）构成，本指两半合验的凭证
column3: a mark or thing that stands for something else
column5: The dove is a symbol of peace.|Each element has a chemical symbol.
column6: one thing put in place of another to point at it – 拿一物代另一物，用来指认它
column7: 符号：约定用来代表某物的记号|象征：所代表的是抽象之义，如和平|标志：代表某个组织或身份的那个记号

column2: 借自拉丁语 symposium ← 希腊语 symposion（宴饮聚会），由 syn-（一同）＋ pino（饮）构成，古希腊人在酒会上论学
column3: a formal meeting at which experts discuss a particular subject
column5: She presented a paper at the symposium.|The symposium ran for three days.
column6: a gathering held so that specialists can talk one subject through – 专为把一个题目谈透而聚的会
column7: 专题研讨会：围绕一个题目、有备而来的会|座谈会：形式更松，与会者轮流发言

column2: 中古英语 sinthoma ← 中世纪拉丁语 sinthoma ← 晚期拉丁语 symptoma ← 希腊语 symptoma（一同落下之事），由 syn-（一同）＋ pipto（落下）构成
column3: a sign of illness that a patient notices or shows
column5: A high fever is the first symptom.|Ignoring early symptoms can be risky.
column6: an outward sign that comes along with the illness itself – 随病一同出现、显在外面的那个迹象
column7: 症状：病在身上显出的表现|征兆：把这层推广开，指任何事将发的先兆

column2: 借自新拉丁语 syndrome ← 希腊语 syndrome（一同奔集），由 syn-（一同）＋ dromos（跑）构成
column3: a set of symptoms that regularly occur together
column5: Doctors named the syndrome after him.|The syndrome affects sleep and appetite.
column6: several signs that keep turning up together, so they are named as one – 几个迹象总是一齐来，于是合起来给一个名
column7: 综合症：作为病名的那一组表现|一组并发表现：强调它们同时出现这一点

column2: 部分借自中古法语 systeme，部分直接取自晚期拉丁语 systema ← 希腊语 systema（组织起来的整体），由 syn-（一同）＋ histemi（立）构成
column3: a set of connected parts that work together as a whole
column5: The heating system broke down last night.|He knows the legal system well.
column6: parts joined so that they act as one working whole – 各部分接在一起，合成一个能运转的整体
column7: 系统：各部件相连、协同运转的那一整套|体系：把这层用到知识或理论上|制度：把它用到人事的规程上

column2: 借自晚期拉丁语 systematicus ← 通用希腊语 systematikos ← systema（组织起来的整体）＋ 形容词后缀 -ikos
column3: done according to a fixed plan or method, step by step
column5: They made a systematic search of the building.|Her notes are systematic and easy to follow.
column6: following a set order instead of going at random – 照定好的次序来，不东一下西一下
column7: 系统的：按整体规划逐项推进|有条理的：条目分明，先后清楚

column2: 中古英语 table ← 古英语 tabule ← 拉丁语 tabula（板、木牌、图表），经日耳曼语支早期借入；「家具」一义另经古法语 table 传入
column3: a piece of furniture with a flat top on legs, or facts arranged in rows
column5: They sat around the kitchen table.|The table shows rainfall by month.
column6: a flat board held up so things can be set out on it – 撑起来的一块平板，东西摊在上面
column7: 桌子：那件家具本身|表格：把数字摊在平面上按行列排开，同是一块平板|搁置：把议案先放到台面上不议，引申为暂缓

column2: 中古英语 tablet ← 古法语 tablete，是 table（板）的指小形 ← 拉丁语 tabula（板）
column3: a small flat piece of medicine, or a flat portable computer
column5: Take one tablet after each meal.|She reads the news on her tablet.
column6: a small flat slab you hold in the hand – 手里拿得住的一小块平板
column7: 药片：压成扁片的药|平板电脑：整机就是一块可握的平板|石板：古时刻字用的那种小平板

column2: 中古英语 takel（索具、装备）← 中古荷兰语／中古低地德语 takel（船上索具），或与 taken（抓、取）相关
column3: to deal with a difficult task, or to bring down an opponent in sport
column5: She tackled the problem head on.|He tackled the striker just outside the box.
column6: getting a firm hold on something in order to deal with it – 先抓住，然后处置
column7: 应对：把难题抓在手里去办|擒抱：球场上抱住对手使其停下|器具：本义是船上那套索具，泛指成套家伙

column2: 借自新拉丁语 tactica ← 希腊语 taktikos（善于排布的）← tasso（排列、部署）
column3: a particular method used to achieve something in the short term
column5: Changing tactics won them the match.|Delay is a common negotiating tactic.
column6: the particular move chosen to gain an advantage now – 为眼下取胜而选定的那一手
column7: 战术：具体一仗一局里的打法|策略：泛指为达目的采用的路数

column2: 中古英语 tagge（衣物上垂下的小片），或出自北日耳曼语支；比较挪威语 tagg（尖、刺）、瑞典语 tagg（刺）
column3: a small piece of paper or cloth attached to something to give information
column5: The price tag was still on the coat.|Each file is tagged with a date.
column6: a small piece fixed on to tell you what a thing is – 挂上去的一小片，用来说明这东西是什么
column7: 吊牌：挂在商品上写着价钱尺码的那片|标记：给东西加上可辨认的记号|附注：在原有内容后添上的一小段说明

column2: 中古英语 tail ← 古英语 tæġl ← 原始日耳曼语 *taglą（毛、尾毛）← 原始印欧语 *doḱ-（尾上的毛）
column3: the part of an animal that sticks out at the back end
column5: The cat's tail twitched once.|Police tailed the van for an hour.
column6: the part that trails at the back end – 拖在最后端的那一截
column7: 尾部：动物身后伸出的那一段|末端：把这层用到物件上，指最后那一头|跟踪：一直缀在人后面，像尾巴那样甩不掉

column2: 中古英语 tale ← 古英语 talu（叙述、计数）← 原始日耳曼语 *talō（计算、数目）← 原始印欧语 *del-（数、算）；与 tell、talk 同支
column3: a story, especially one that is old or made up
column5: He told us a tale of shipwreck.|Local tales say the well never dries.
column6: a story told from one person to the next – 一个人讲给另一个人、这样传下来的故事
column7: 故事：讲出来的一段情事|传说：口耳相传、年头已久的那种

column2: 中古英语 talent ← 古英语 talente，借自拉丁语 talentum（希腊的一种重量与钱币单位）← 希腊语 talanton（天平、一定的重量）；「天资」义出自圣经银子的比喻
column3: a natural ability to do something well
column5: She has a real talent for languages.|The team is short of young talent.
column6: an ability one is born with rather than taught – 生来就有、不是学来的那份能力
column7: 才能：能做好某事的本事|天赋：强调这本事得自天生|人才：把这份本事落到具体的人身上

column2: 中古英语 talken ← 古英语 *tealcian（谈、闲话）← 原始日耳曼语 *talkōną（说、闲谈），是 *talōną（数、述）的反复体；与 tell 同支
column3: to say things to someone as part of a conversation
column5: They talked for an hour about the plan.|He gave a talk on bird migration.
column6: putting words back and forth between people – 话在人与人之间来回递
column7: 交谈：两人以上互相说与听|谈论：把话题落到某一件事上|演讲：一人对众人成段地说

column2: 中古英语 tal（体面的、出色的）← 古英语 ġetæl（敏捷的、有把握的）← 原始日耳曼语 *talaz ← 原始印欧语 *del-（数、量）；词义几经转折才落到「高」上
column3: having greater than average height
column5: He is tall enough to reach the shelf.|A tall hedge hid the garden.
column6: measuring more from bottom to top than most – 从下到上量起来比多数都长
column7: 高的：物体的竖向尺寸大|个子高的：专说人的身高

column2: 中古英语 tame ← 古英语 tam（已驯的）← 原始日耳曼语 *tamaz（被带进家中的）← 原始印欧语 *demh₂-（驯服、制服）
column3: no longer wild, used to being near people
column5: The deer here are surprisingly tame.|It took months to tame the young horse.
column6: brought in close enough to people to stop fearing them – 与人处得够近，不再怕人
column7: 驯服的：野性已去，肯听人摆布|温顺的：性子和顺，不抵触|使驯化：把野的变成这样这个过程

column2: 中古英语 tan ← 古法语 tan（鞣皮用的树皮）← 高卢语 *tannos（青槠），更早词源不明；动词「鞣制」← 古英语晚期 tannian ← 拉丁语 tannare
column3: to become brown from the sun, or the brown colour this gives
column5: His arms tanned quickly in the sun.|The workshop tans hides by hand.
column6: turning a hide or skin brown and tough – 把皮变成褐色、也变得更韧
column7: 晒黑：日光把皮肤晒成褐色|棕褐色：那种颜色本身|鞣制：用树皮汁把生皮做成革，本义在此

column2: 中古英语 tanglen，或出自北日耳曼语支；比较瑞典语 taggla（弄乱）、古诺尔斯语 þang（海藻，纠成一团者）
column3: to twist together into a confused mass
column5: The wires tangled behind the desk.|Do not get tangled in their dispute.
column6: strands crossing each other until no end can be found – 几条互相穿绕，找不出哪是头
column7: 缠结：几股绞在一起解不开|纠缠：把这层用到人事上，脱不了身|乱成一团：强调结果的杂乱

column2: 借自葡萄牙语 tanque（水池、盛液容器）← 印度语言，或古吉拉特语 tanki（蓄水池）；「装甲车」义 1915 年造，当时为掩其用途谎称是运水容器
column3: a large container for liquid or gas, or an armoured fighting vehicle
column5: The water tank holds two thousand litres.|Tanks rolled across the open ground.
column6: a large closed container that holds what would otherwise run out – 大而封闭的容器，装住本会流走的东西
column7: 储罐：装液体或气体的大容器|水箱：专装水的那种|坦克：一战时为掩护其真用途，谎称是运水容器，名字就留下了

column2: 由 tank ＋ -er 构成；tank 一支 ← 葡萄牙语 tanque（水池）← 印度语言
column3: a ship, lorry, or aircraft built to carry liquid in bulk
column5: The tanker docked at the oil terminal.|A milk tanker collects from each farm.
column6: a vehicle whose body is one large container for liquid – 车身或船身本身就是一个装液体的大容器
column7: 油轮：运原油或油品的那种船|罐车：陆上运液体的那种车

column2: 中古英语 tappe（放液的塞、龙头）← 古英语 tæppa ← 原始日耳曼语 *tappô（塞子、尖木）；动词「轻击」义另出，为拟声
column3: to strike something lightly, or a device that controls the flow of liquid
column5: She tapped twice on the window.|Turn off the tap before you leave.
column6: a light knock, or the plug that lets liquid out – 轻轻一击，或放液体出来的那个塞
column7: 叩击：手指或器物轻碰一下|龙头：控制水流出的那件装置，本义即塞子|开发利用：把封着的资源放出来用，如同开塞放液

column2: 中古英语 tape ← 古英语 tæppe（带、条），更早词源不明；或与古弗里斯兰语 tapia（拉、扯）相关
column3: a long narrow strip of material, often sticky or used for recording
column5: He sealed the box with tape.|The interview is on tape.
column6: a long narrow strip wound on a roll – 卷在轴上的一条长窄带
column7: 胶带：一面带黏胶的那种|磁带：可录声音影像的那种|卷尺：印着刻度、可卷起的那种

column2: 中古英语 ter ← 古英语 teoru ← 原始日耳曼语 *terwą ← 原始印欧语 *dóru（树），本指从松木熬出的黑稠汁；与 tree 同源
column3: a thick black sticky substance made from wood or coal, used on roads
column5: Fresh tar covered the new road.|Tar stuck to the soles of his boots.
column6: a thick black liquid that sets hard and seals what it covers – 又黑又稠的液体，干后结硬把底下封住
column7: 焦油：木材或煤干馏得出的那种黑稠液|柏油：铺路用的那种，同物而偏重用途

column2: 中古法语 targette，是 targe（小盾）的指小形 ← 古法语 ← 法兰克语 *targa（圆盾）← 原始日耳曼语 *targǭ（边缘）
column3: the thing aimed at, or a result one is trying to reach
column5: The arrow struck the target dead centre.|We met our sales target for the year.
column6: the one thing all the aiming is directed at – 所有瞄准都对着的那一处
column7: 目标：要达到的那个结果|靶子：射击瞄准的那块板，本义是小盾|对象：动作或政策所指向的那一方

column2: 源自意大利语 tariffa（税则表）← 阿拉伯语 taʿrif（告知、说明），1592 年始见于英语
column3: a tax on goods coming into a country, or a published list of charges
column5: The government raised tariffs on steel.|Check the tariff before you call abroad.
column6: a published schedule saying what each item costs to bring in or use – 公布出来的一份表，写明每项收多少
column7: 关税：货物进境时按表征收的税|价目表：把各项收费逐条列出的那份表
